scripts.wasm: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go -C ../reel build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o "$PWD/public/reel.wasm" ./internal/inspector && gzip -9nf -S .gzip public/reel.wasm && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" public/wasm_exec.js
scripts.samples: rm -rf public/samples && mkdir -p public/samples && REEL_INSPECTOR_SAMPLES="$PWD/public/samples" go -C ../_examples test -count=1 -run '^TestInspectorSamples$' ./steep-simple/ ./steep-showcase/
scripts.assets: bun run wasm && bun run samples
